001package org.clafer.ast;
002
003import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.arithm;
004import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.card;
005import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.compare;
006import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.concat;
007import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.connected;
008import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.decl;
009import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.diff;
010import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.domainRestriction;
011import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.downcast;
012import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.ifThenElse;
013import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.inter;
014import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.inverse;
015import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.join;
016import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.joinParent;
017import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.joinRef;
018import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.length;
019import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.max;
020import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.membership;
021import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.min;
022import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.minus;
023import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.mod;
024import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.not;
025import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.prefix;
026import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.product;
027import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.quantify;
028import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.rangeRestriction;
029import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.suffix;
030import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.sum;
031import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.test;
032import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.transitiveClosure;
033import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.union;
034import static org.clafer.ast.Asts.upcast;
035
036/**
037 *
038 * @param <T> the parameter type
039 * @author jimmy
040 */
041public abstract class AstExprRewriter<T> {
042
043    /**
044     * Rewrites an expression by the method for its kind.
045     *
046     * @param expr the expression
047     * @param t the parameter
048     * @return the rewritten expression
049     */
050    public AstExpr rewrite(AstExpr expr, T t) {
051        return switch (expr) {
052            case AstArithm e -> visit(e, t);
053            case AstBoolArithm e -> visit(e, t);
054            case AstCard e -> visit(e, t);
055            case AstChildRelation e -> visit(e, t);
056            case AstCompare e -> visit(e, t);
057            case AstConcat e -> visit(e, t);
058            case AstConnected e -> visit(e, t);
059            case AstConstant e -> visit(e, t);
060            case AstDecimalConstant e -> visit(e, t);
061            case AstDifference e -> visit(e, t);
062            case AstDomainRestriction e -> visit(e, t);
063            case AstDowncast e -> visit(e, t);
064            case AstGlobal e -> visit(e, t);
065            case AstIfThenElse e -> visit(e, t);
066            case AstIntersection e -> visit(e, t);
067            case AstInverse e -> visit(e, t);
068            case AstJoin e -> visit(e, t);
069            case AstJoinParent e -> visit(e, t);
070            case AstJoinRef e -> visit(e, t);
071            case AstLength e -> visit(e, t);
072            case AstLocal e -> visit(e, t);
073            case AstMax e -> visit(e, t);
074            case AstMembership e -> visit(e, t);
075            case AstMin e -> visit(e, t);
076            case AstMinus e -> visit(e, t);
077            case AstMod e -> visit(e, t);
078            case AstNot e -> visit(e, t);
079            case AstParentRelation e -> visit(e, t);
080            case AstPrefix e -> visit(e, t);
081            case AstProduct e -> visit(e, t);
082            case AstQuantify e -> visit(e, t);
083            case AstRangeRestriction e -> visit(e, t);
084            case AstRefRelation e -> visit(e, t);
085            case AstSetTest e -> visit(e, t);
086            case AstStringConstant e -> visit(e, t);
087            case AstSuffix e -> visit(e, t);
088            case AstSum e -> visit(e, t);
089            case AstTernary e -> visit(e, t);
090            case AstThis e -> visit(e, t);
091            case AstTransitiveClosure e -> visit(e, t);
092            case AstUnion e -> visit(e, t);
093            case AstUpcast e -> visit(e, t);
094        };
095    }
096
097    public AstBoolExpr rewrite(AstBoolExpr expr, T t) {
098        return (AstBoolExpr) rewrite((AstExpr) expr, t);
099    }
100
101    public AstBoolExpr[] rewrite(AstBoolExpr[] exprs, T t) {
102        AstBoolExpr[] rewritten = new AstBoolExpr[exprs.length];
103        for (int i = 0; i < rewritten.length; i++) {
104            rewritten[i] = rewrite(exprs[i], t);
105        }
106        return rewritten;
107    }
108
109    public AstSetExpr rewrite(AstSetExpr expr, T t) {
110        return (AstSetExpr) rewrite((AstExpr) expr, t);
111    }
112
113    public AstSetExpr[] rewrite(AstSetExpr[] exprs, T t) {
114        AstSetExpr[] rewritten = new AstSetExpr[exprs.length];
115        for (int i = 0; i < rewritten.length; i++) {
116            rewritten[i] = rewrite(exprs[i], t);
117        }
118        return rewritten;
119    }
120
121    public AstExpr visit(AstThis ast, T a) {
122        return ast;
123    }
124
125    public AstExpr visit(AstGlobal ast, T a) {
126        return ast;
127    }
128
129    public AstExpr visit(AstConstant ast, T a) {
130        return ast;
131    }
132
133    public AstExpr visit(AstStringConstant ast, T a) {
134        return ast;
135    }
136
137    public AstExpr visit(AstDecimalConstant ast, T a) {
138        return ast;
139    }
140
141    public AstExpr visit(AstJoin ast, T a) {
142        return join(rewrite(ast.left(), a), ast.right());
143    }
144
145    public AstExpr visit(AstJoinParent ast, T a) {
146        return joinParent(rewrite(ast.children(), a));
147    }
148
149    public AstExpr visit(AstJoinRef ast, T a) {
150        return joinRef(rewrite(ast.deref(), a));
151    }
152
153    public AstExpr visit(AstNot ast, T a) {
154        return not(rewrite(ast.expr(), a));
155    }
156
157    public AstExpr visit(AstMinus ast, T a) {
158        return minus(rewrite(ast.expr(), a));
159    }
160
161    public AstExpr visit(AstCard ast, T a) {
162        return card(rewrite(ast.set(), a));
163    }
164
165    public AstExpr visit(AstMax ast, T a) {
166        return max(rewrite(ast.set(), a));
167    }
168
169    public AstExpr visit(AstMin ast, T a) {
170        return min(rewrite(ast.set(), a));
171    }
172
173    public AstExpr visit(AstSetTest ast, T a) {
174        return test(rewrite(ast.left(), a), ast.op(), rewrite(ast.right(), a));
175    }
176
177    public AstExpr visit(AstCompare ast, T a) {
178        return compare(rewrite(ast.left(), a), ast.op(), rewrite(ast.right(), a));
179    }
180
181    public AstExpr visit(AstArithm ast, T a) {
182        return arithm(ast.op(), rewrite(ast.operands(), a));
183    }
184
185    public AstExpr visit(AstMod ast, T a) {
186        return mod(rewrite(ast.dividend(), a), rewrite(ast.divisor(), a));
187    }
188
189    public AstExpr visit(AstSum ast, T a) {
190        return sum(rewrite(ast.set(), a));
191    }
192
193    public AstExpr visit(AstProduct ast, T a) {
194        return product(rewrite(ast.set(), a));
195    }
196
197    public AstExpr visit(AstBoolArithm ast, T a) {
198        return arithm(ast.op(), rewrite(ast.operands(), a));
199    }
200
201    public AstExpr visit(AstDifference ast, T a) {
202        return diff(rewrite(ast.left(), a), rewrite(ast.right(), a));
203    }
204
205    public AstExpr visit(AstIntersection ast, T a) {
206        return inter(rewrite(ast.left(), a), rewrite(ast.right(), a));
207    }
208
209    public AstExpr visit(AstUnion ast, T a) {
210        return union(rewrite(ast.left(), a), rewrite(ast.right(), a));
211    }
212
213    public AstExpr visit(AstMembership ast, T a) {
214        return membership(rewrite(ast.member(), a), ast.op(), rewrite(ast.set(), a));
215    }
216
217    public AstExpr visit(AstTernary ast, T a) {
218        return ifThenElse(rewrite(ast.antecedent(), a), rewrite(ast.consequent(), a), rewrite(ast.alternative(), a));
219    }
220
221    public AstExpr visit(AstIfThenElse ast, T a) {
222        return ifThenElse(rewrite(ast.antecedent(), a), rewrite(ast.consequent(), a), rewrite(ast.alternative(), a));
223    }
224
225    public AstExpr visit(AstDowncast ast, T a) {
226        return downcast(rewrite(ast.base(), a), ast.target());
227    }
228
229    public AstExpr visit(AstUpcast ast, T a) {
230        return upcast(rewrite(ast.base(), a), ast.target());
231    }
232
233    public AstExpr visit(AstLocal ast, T a) {
234        return ast;
235    }
236
237    public AstExpr visit(AstQuantify ast, T a) {
238        AstDecl[] decls = new AstDecl[ast.decls().length];
239        for (int i = 0; i < decls.length; i++) {
240            AstDecl decl = ast.decls()[i];
241            AstLocal[] locals = new AstLocal[decl.getLocals().length];
242            for (int j = 0; j < locals.length; j++) {
243                locals[j] = (AstLocal) rewrite(decl.getLocals()[j], a);
244            }
245            decls[i] = decl(decl.isDisjoint(), locals, rewrite(decl.getBody(), a));
246        }
247        return quantify(ast.quantifier(), decls, rewrite(ast.body(), a));
248    }
249
250    public AstExpr visit(AstLength ast, T a) {
251        return length(rewrite(ast.string(), a));
252    }
253
254    public AstExpr visit(AstConcat ast, T a) {
255        return concat(rewrite(ast.left(), a), rewrite(ast.right(), a));
256    }
257
258    public AstExpr visit(AstPrefix ast, T a) {
259        return prefix(rewrite(ast.prefix(), a), rewrite(ast.word(), a));
260    }
261
262    public AstExpr visit(AstSuffix ast, T a) {
263        return suffix(rewrite(ast.suffix(), a), rewrite(ast.word(), a));
264    }
265
266    public AstExpr visit(AstChildRelation ast, T a) {
267        return ast;
268    }
269
270    public AstExpr visit(AstParentRelation ast, T a) {
271        return ast;
272    }
273
274    public AstExpr visit(AstRefRelation ast, T a) {
275        return ast;
276    }
277
278    public AstExpr visit(AstDomainRestriction ast, T a) {
279        return domainRestriction(rewrite(ast.domain(), a), rewrite(ast.relation(), a));
280    }
281
282    public AstExpr visit(AstRangeRestriction ast, T a) {
283        return rangeRestriction(rewrite(ast.relation(), a), rewrite(ast.range(), a));
284    }
285
286    public AstExpr visit(AstInverse ast, T a) {
287        return inverse(rewrite(ast.relation(), a));
288    }
289
290    public AstExpr visit(AstTransitiveClosure ast, T a) {
291        return transitiveClosure(rewrite(ast.relation(), a), ast.reflexive());
292    }
293
294    public AstExpr visit(AstConnected ast, T a) {
295        AstSetExpr e = rewrite(ast.relation(), a);
296        AstSetExpr n = rewrite(ast.nodes(), a);
297        return connected(n, e, ast.directed());
298    }
299}
